title: Profile picture doesn't update

text.body: I uploaded a new profile picture yesterday. It shows in settings, but in shared notes my old picture is still shown next to my comments. I tried logging out and in.

gold.rationale: "My old picture is still shown next to my comments": a minor single-user bug.

title: eu-west storage cluster at 91%

text.body: Object storage cluster `eu-w-store-2` is at 91% used. Growth over the last 7 days averages 1.8%/day, so it's full in ~5 days. At 98% the cluster goes read-only and uploads in eu-west would fail. New nodes are on order but delivery takes 3 weeks.

gold.rationale: Storage "at 91% used" and "full in ~5 days", after which uploads fail: capacity running out within days.

title: Outbound email quota nearly used up

text.body: Our transactional email provider shows 96% of the monthly sending quota used, and the quota resets in 6 days. At the current rate we hit 100% in about 2 days, after which password reset, sign-up confirmation and invite emails will not be sent. Raising the plan needs a finance approval.

gold.rationale: Email quota "96% ... used" and "hit 100% in about 2 days", after which password reset and invite emails stop: a quota running out within days despite the P4.

title: Files uploaded during the night return 404

text.body:
Support has 6 tickets this morning from us-east customers: attachments uploaded last night show in the note, but downloading returns 404 `NoSuchObject`. All six were uploaded between 01:00 and 03:00 UTC, which is the storage migration window (bucket move from `nw-files-use1-a` to `-b`). The objects are not in the new bucket, and the old bucket was emptied at 03:10 by the migration's cleanup step.

I set P3 because each customer only has a few files, but I think everything uploaded in that window is gone.
text.customer_impact: Every upload in us-east between 01:00 and 03:00 UTC; customer count unknown.

gold.rationale: Objects uploaded in the migration window "are not in the new bucket, and the old bucket was emptied": "everything uploaded in that window is gone", despite the P3.

title: How to set up two-factor authentication

text.body: Our company policy now requires two-factor authentication for all apps. Where do I turn it on in Northwind, and can I use an authenticator app instead of SMS? Also, can an admin enforce it for everyone in the workspace?

gold.rationale: "Where do I turn it on" for two-factor authentication: a how-to question.

title: API keys visible in page source of public share pages

text.body:
I'm a developer looking at one of your public share links (`share.northwind.example/p/...`). The HTML source contains a script tag with `window.__NW_STATE__` that includes `"ownerApiKey":"nwk_live_..."`. I tried three different public pages from the community gallery and each one has a different key. I did NOT use any of the keys, but going by the API docs a key gives full read/write access to the owner's workspace.

Reporting responsibly; happy to share the page URLs privately.
text.customer_impact: Every workspace with a public share page.

gold.rationale: Public share pages include "ownerApiKey" in the HTML, and "a key gives full read/write access to the owner's workspace": secrets exposed to anyone.

title: Elevated 5xx on attachment uploads in eu-west

text.body: The attachment upload error rate in eu-west went from the usual 0.05% to about 3% at 12:50 UTC. Errors are 502s from the upload gateway, spread across customers. Client retries succeed on the second attempt most of the time, so users mostly see a slow upload. Other regions are normal.
text.customer_impact: About 3% of uploads fail first time; retries usually succeed.

gold.rationale: Upload errors "went from the usual 0.05% to about 3%" and "retries succeed": elevated errors, degraded but working.

title: Web app shows a blank white page

text.body:
QA here. After the 14:30 frontend release, app.northwind.example loads a blank white page. The console shows `Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token '<'` in `main.7f3c1a.js` (looks like the bundle URL returns the HTML index instead of JS). Reproduced from three regions via VPN, on four browsers, and with a clean profile. Desktop and mobile apps still work.

Filed as P2 since desktop is fine, but I think every web user is affected.
text.customer_impact: Nobody can use the web app; desktop and mobile apps still work.

gold.rationale: The web app "loads a blank white page", reproduced "from three regions" and "on four browsers": every web user is down even though it was filed P2.

title: CRITICAL - need dark mode before our board meeting

text.body: CRITICAL: our CEO presents from Northwind on Monday in a dark room and the white background is blinding. Can you enable dark mode for our workspace before then? If it doesn't exist yet please treat this as a top priority feature request.

gold.rationale: "CRITICAL" and "top priority" on a request to "enable dark mode for our workspace": a feature request.

title: Everything I wrote in October has gone back to September

text.body:
This morning all my notebooks show the content from mid-September. Everything I wrote in October (about 30 notes, including client meeting notes) is not there, on my laptop, my phone, or the web. Version history for those notes ends on 16 September as well; the October versions aren't in the list.

I did nothing special, just opened the laptop. Last night around 23:00 the app showed "Restoring workspace..." for a few minutes, which I'd never seen before.

Account: workspace ws_20417 (pro)
text.customer_impact: One month of notes for this user; possibly others restored the same night.

gold.rationale: A month of notes "is not there, on my laptop, my phone, or the web" and "the October versions aren't in the list" of history: customer data is gone.

title: How do I export a notebook to PDF?

text.body: Hi, I need to send one of my notebooks to a client as a PDF. I can see "Export" in the menu but it only offers Markdown and HTML. Is PDF possible, or do I need to print it to PDF from the browser? Thanks!

gold.rationale: The reporter picked "P1", which sets the T1 floor, but the content is only a how-to question: "Is PDF possible".

title: Sync conflict warning, no data was lost

text.body: Yesterday I edited the same note on my laptop and my phone while on a plane. When I landed I got a "Sync conflict" message and Northwind kept both versions. No data was lost, both versions are there and I merged them by hand. I just want to understand: is there a way to avoid this, or to merge automatically?

gold.rationale: "No data was lost, both versions are there"; the user only wants to understand sync conflicts.

title: FYI short slowness yesterday, not an outage

text.body: Just FYI, no action needed: yesterday around 15:20 UTC the app was slow for about a minute (notes took a few seconds to open). Not an outage, nothing failed, everything has been fine since. Our IT team asked me to report it anyway in case you see a pattern.

gold.rationale: "Not an outage, nothing failed, everything has been fine since": a one-minute slowdown sent as FYI.

title: Please support tables in the editor

text.body: I'd love to be able to insert simple tables in notes (even Markdown-style pipes). Right now I use screenshots of spreadsheets, which aren't searchable.

gold.rationale: "I'd love to be able to insert simple tables": a feature request.

title: search really slow

text.body: Search has been taking 20-30 seconds to return anything since this morning (normally it's instant). Not just me: my colleagues in Mumbai and Singapore have the same, and so do two friends who use Northwind for personal notes. Everything else works, notes open fast, sync is fine.

gold.rationale: Search "taking 20-30 seconds" for the customer and "my colleagues in Mumbai and Singapore" while everything else works: regional degraded service, not a single-user bug.

title: Retention job removed active workspaces

text.body:
The nightly retention job (`purge-expired-workspaces`) ran at 11:00 UTC instead of 03:00 after yesterday's scheduler change and deleted 12 workspaces that were NOT expired: all had active subscriptions. Their owners are getting "workspace not found". The job hard-deletes metadata and schedules blob deletion in 24h.

The job is disabled now. We need to decide fast whether the blob deletion can be cancelled.
text.customer_impact: 12 workspaces (4 business, 8 pro) currently show as not found.

gold.rationale: The retention job "deleted 12 workspaces that were NOT expired" and "hard-deletes metadata": paying customers' data removed.

title: ASAP: change our billing email address

text.body: Please do this ASAP!! Our finance contact left and invoices still go to her address. Please change the billing email to finance@example.com. I'm the workspace owner (ws_22190).

gold.rationale: "Please do this ASAP!!" on a request to "change the billing email": an ordinary billing question.

title: Image previews not showing for new uploads

text.body: Since about 07:00 UTC no new image upload gets a thumbnail; notes show the grey placeholder. Clicking the placeholder opens the full image fine, so the files themselves are OK. The thumbnail queue has 182k jobs waiting and the worker logs show `thumbnailer: missing codec library`. It started after this morning's base image update.
text.customer_impact: All new image uploads show a placeholder instead of a preview.

gold.rationale: "No new image upload gets a thumbnail" for any customer since 07:00, but "the files themselves are OK": degraded service, not data loss.

title: Charged twice this month?

text.body: My bank statement shows two charges of 8.00 EUR from Northwind on 1 September. I only have one account (pro, monthly). Can you check and refund one if it's a duplicate?

gold.rationale: One customer sees "two charges of 8.00 EUR" for one monthly plan: a single-user billing question.

title: Cert renewal job failing for files domain

text.body: The weekly certificate check says the TLS certificate for `files.northwind.example` expires on 24 October (4 days). The automatic renewal job has failed every night since 13 October with `DNS challenge record not found` (the DNS zone moved to a new provider last week). Nothing is broken yet. If it expires, every attachment download will fail.

gold.rationale: The TLS certificate for files.northwind.example "expires on 24 October (4 days)" and renewal "has failed every night": a certificate expiring within days.

title: Sync API returning 503 for all requests in us-east

text.body:
Synthetic checks for `sync.us-east.northwind.example` started failing at 02:06 UTC. Every request returns 503 from the load balancer and the backend pool shows 0/24 healthy. The last deploy to this pool was at 01:58 (sync-api 2026.09.02-3). eu-west and ap-south pools are healthy.

Rollback not started yet, waiting for whoever owns sync-api tonight.

gold.rationale: "Every request returns 503" and "0/24 healthy" for the us-east sync API: a regional outage.

title: Need copy of September invoice

text.body: Hello, our auditor needs a copy of the September invoice with our VAT number on it. The one on the billing page shows our old company address. Could you send a corrected copy to accounts@example.com? Our audit meeting is next week.

gold.rationale: "P1" priority sets the T1 floor, but the content is a billing request for "a copy of the September invoice".

title: Note titles cut off in the mobile sidebar

text.body: On my phone (small screen) long note titles in the sidebar are cut off after ~20 characters with no "..." and I can't see the rest unless I open the note. Not a big deal, just a bit annoying.

gold.rationale: Long titles are "cut off after ~20 characters" on one user's phone, "not a big deal": a cosmetic single-user bug.

title: How do I get back a note I deleted?

text.body: I deleted a note by mistake this morning. Is there a trash or a way to get it back? I'm on the free plan if that matters.

gold.rationale: "I deleted a note by mistake ... Is there a trash or a way to get it back?": a how-to question from one user.

title: Changes take 10-15 minutes to show on other devices

text.body: Sync fan-out lag in us-east is at 11-15 minutes (normal is under 5 seconds). The change-feed consumer group is behind by ~2.1M events after the broker failover at 14:50 UTC. Edits are saved and eventually arrive. We're getting a few customer chats asking why their phone doesn't show the latest note.
text.customer_impact: us-east users see delayed sync between devices.

gold.rationale: Sync lag "at 11-15 minutes (normal under 5 seconds)" in us-east while "edits are saved and eventually arrive": degraded service.
